World Bank: US Poor Richer Than India's Richest

The poorest 10% in the United States have a higher daily income threshold than the richest 10% in India, according to a World Bank report. This comparison indicates that the poorest segment of the US population surpasses the wealthiest segment of India's population in terms of daily income thresholds.
